title: Explicit tensor, support and pullback factors of finite evaluation
statement: In the setting of [def-sf-integral-projection-finite-evaluation-data] and [def-sf-integral-system-operations], evaluatedTensor is the ambient transported fixed-coefficient tensor, and SystemTensorEvaluation is a natural comparison of evaluated system tensor with that tensor of the evaluated inputs. Define evaluatedSupport using the actual system supportEvaluation, reductionEvaluation, and the inverse of finiteSupport. Define evaluatedPull using pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation, reductionEvaluation, and the inverse of finitePullback. Define evaluatedInput, evaluatedSource and evaluatedTarget as the displayed composites of those comparisons. All are explicit constructions with supplied arguments; none selects arbitrary data from an unproved existence statement.
